name: Premium 15' Aluminum Tent Frame (Silver)
descriptionHtml:
Features:
Frame is constructed of 1.1 mm anodized aluminum
Frame features ABS glass-filled nylon joints
Hexagon-shaped legs are 1.75" in diameter
Legs feature plastic levers for pinch-free height adjustment
Easy-Glide Tent Feet allow the tent frame to slide on dirt and grass, preventing the legs from catching
Frame must be secured to the ground to prevent wind damage (failure to secure the tent voids the warranty)


Product Dimensions

15ft:
Product Size: 175.5" W x 139.25" H x 126.75" D
Collapsible Dimensions: 12.12" W x 62.75" H x 9.37" D
Product Weight: 46 lbs


Kit Include
1: Hardware (Frame)


Materials
Hardware: ABS Nylon, Aluminum


Primary Usage
Outdoor


Order Cutoff Time
2:00 PM Central Daylight Time


Warranty
lifetime hardware warranty - Standard warranty is a parts and labor warranty which warrants product against defects in material and workmanship. It does not cover damage due to accidents, abuse, or normal wear and tear. Products found to be defective will be replaced or repaired at factory's discretion.

howToOrderHtml:
3 Easy Steps

Step 1: Shop 🛒

Pick your products and add-ons, then add your order to the cart.

Step 2: Payment 💳

Go to your cart and choose your payment option:

Full payment: your design gets priority 🚀

Deposit: start the design now and pay the remaining balance after artwork approval

(Deposit option applies only to orders over $295 USD. Orders below this amount require full payment.)

Step 3: Artwork 🎨

Complete checkout and upload your artwork using the provided link.

Don’t see it? No worries — we’ll email it to you.
